textTemplates.name: welcome_question_dref_tt
textTemplates.text:
Dear Professor,
As the course comes to a close, we want to express our sincere gratitude for your dedication and expertise throughout the term.
In order for us to understand what went well during the term and what are the opportunity areas for us to improve upon, we request you to fill in in this short feedback form as it will help us in realigning our efforts in the right direction to make your teaching experience better.
Instructions: Rate the following feedback parameters on a scale of 1 to 5, rating descriptors are given below for your reference.
Excellent (5): Professional, timely, and exceeded expectations; support was thorough and tailored. Good (4): Prompt and effective; support was clear and met most expectations. Average (3): Adequate support that met basic needs, with room for improvement. Poor (2): Somewhat helpful but delayed or lacking detail; did not fully meet expectations. Very Poor (1): Inadequate or unhelpful; issues were not addressed in a timely or effective manner.
N/A - If the particular parameter is not applicable in your case.
